summary: Multi-track schedule that composes the existing semantic agendas.
whenToUse: Comparing the schedules of multiple tracks side by side.
whenNotToUse: A single sequence of sessions: compose Agenda and AgendaItem directly.

props.name: headingLevel
props.description: Heading level of the schedule title.

keyboard.action: Navigates session links and actions in DOM order.

accessibility: Each track reuses Agenda and each session reuses AgendaItem for the list structure and time metadata.
responsive: Tracks form responsive columns that collapse to a single column when needed.
customization: Uses --dc-* tokens and className on the container.
commonMistakes: Don’t assume that parallel columns represent a global chronological order.
limits: Does not provide filtering or synchronization controls across tracks.
